rows.title: Reply to Clarification- Financial results
rows.summary: The Exchange had sought clarification from GHCL Limited for the quarter ended 30-Jun-2026 with respect to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. On basis of above the Company was required to clarify the following:   -1. Consolidated Financial Results not submitted The response of the Company is enclosed.
